title: Neutrino agreement identity
description: The portable semantic-agreement identity (). agreementHash = sha256( frame(domain) || frame(semanticLanguageVersion) || frame(canonicalCapabilitySpecBytes) || frame(canonicalAgreementEnvelopeBytes) ), where frame(x) = BE64(byteLength(x)) || x. The capability-spec stays the external semantic contract; the versioned envelope carries the identity-level semantics absent from it (consent/amendment policy, clause semantic IDs). Realization-only data never contributes.

domain.description: The domain-separation tag hashed into the preimage; the trailing .vN is the identity-object domain version. An unknown domain fails closed.

semanticLanguageVersion.description: The semantic-agreement language version the identity is expressed in; pinned to the known/supported set (VersionInfo.h kSemanticLanguageVersion). An unknown version fails closed on ingest — a consumer must not accept an identity whose language version it cannot interpret.

capabilityHash.description: sha256 of canonicalCapabilitySpecBytes (the capability-spec's canonical semantic core) — the SAME value the capability-spec's identity.capabilityHash carries. Present for traceability; the agreementHash preimage binds the bytes, not this digest.

envelope.description: The versioned agreement envelope: identity-level semantics carried alongside the capability-spec. Greenfield in S1 — policies default to null, clauseSemanticIds is empty; later slices author them.

schemaVersion.description: The agreement-envelope schema version; an unknown version fails closed on ingest.

clauseSemanticIds.description: Semantic IDs of the agreement's clauses (empty until authored).
